# SENO Biotech — Racing Pigeon Genetic Testing

> Zhangjiakou SENO Biotech Co., Ltd. (National High-Tech Enterprise) — racing pigeon gene-testing platform for flight-gene testing, pathogen testing, and DNA ID / kinship verification.

## Core Testing Services

- [Flight Gene Test](https://senopigeon.com/en/flight-gene-test/): Analysis of 8 gene loci — LDHA, DRD4, CRY1, MSTN, LRP8, GSR, CASK, F-KER — as a candidate-gene reference based on published pigeon research.
- [Pathogen Testing](https://senopigeon.com/en/pathogen-testing/): Covers 12 common pathogens (viruses, bacteria, fungi, parasites) via real-time qPCR, enabling early detection before clinical signs appear.
- [DNA ID & Kinship](https://senopigeon.com/en/dna-id-kinship/): STR microsatellite markers build a unique DNA fingerprint for each pigeon, scientifically confirming parentage.
